W.note: Frosted glass pill with a drifting light and nice halo, but the small label and low-contrast resting button feel weak, and the effect stays fairly subtle.

X.note: Gradient shift with a drifting light blob, overshoot bezier and arrow nudge reads clearly dreamy, with strong label contrast and a polished card, though 1s transitions run long.

Y.note: Careful bezier set, clean focus ring and reduced-motion handling, but the glow is subtle and the stacked buttons including Sold out clutter the demo.

Z.note: Pastel iridescent pill with a blurred bloom and gentle arrow drift feels airy and legible, with good focus outline and reduced-motion override.
